message: 1 delegated harvester(s) have not been run by their host inside the 10-day cap: research/imagery_video.py on mac-batch (last run: never; last success: never). This host cannot run it and the host that can has been silent, so the pool it feeds has stopped growing.
unblock: mac-batch: wake the Mac (launchd fires the missed 23:00 batch on wake) or run bin/batch-session.sh on it by hand. The next run there stamps loop/state/harvest_runs.json and this clears on its own.
disposition_why: A harvester is declared to run on another host (research/imagery_video.py on the Mac's nightly batch - the only machine with ffmpeg and Apple Vision) and loop/state/harvest_runs.json shows that host has not run it inside harvest.delegated_max_age_days. The lane raising this cannot run it and cannot start the Mac; she can, by waking it or running bin/batch-session.sh. The stamp the next run writes clears this on its own. Not needs_human, because a Mac that has been asleep for ten days is not a defect in the pipeline; not self_resolving, because no amount of waiting turns the Mac on. Only she can clear this, and retrying cannot, so the run stays GREEN and the fact is carried to the top of the Sunday digest instead of into her inbox as a failed build. (run 1 of at most 2 before this escalates.)
